reference: Original DOS6 bios/msdisk.asm and complete current module. Formal makefile defines DOS7_CONFIG for both assemblers.
changes: Remove 139 DOS7_CONFIG selectors and inactive DOS6 alternatives. Move SetDrive header past intervening dsk_init and BYTE_SYSINIT below file header. Correct moved-owner, boot-result, buffer and set-owner flag comments. Document media-ID copy and extended dispatch/transfer/retry interfaces in the surrounding Microsoft style.
necessity: Extended disk addressing and its packet remain in original msdisk owner. CHS and extended INT 13h flows serve different drive capabilities and are required paths. Do not merge again/ext_again into one emitted routine: their existing call targets and two code bodies are part of the accepted layout. A new macro merely to share this short body would add abstraction without removing either emitted copy.
preserved: All original common disk routines, error mapping, data order, retry behavior, far-buffer handling, DOS7 media constraints and stack-unwinding dispatch retained. Explicit long-branch bridges and raw cmp encoding remain unchanged for binary identity.

validation.reason: All 1252 selected assembler statements including literals and directives remain in the same order; comments and known-build branch wrappers only.
validation.binary_baseline: P11 accepted BIOS/IO.SYS and T11 accepted COMMAND.COM/MSDOS.SYS unchanged.
